id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_120.pack|cs_: "Master, it is Hendrik. ...It has been a long time.
"Hendrik, you rascal! More than ten years since you finished training and left town. Come closer and show your face.
"...I've heard plenty about you. A big lump who was only good for his size is now Heliodor's hero! Ha ha!
"You seem healthier than I expected. Without your chivalry lessons, I would not be who I am.
"...Much has happened since I left. The Dundrasil tragedy sixteen years ago, then the Tree's fall, and now Mordegon...
"By the way, where is Sylvando? {var:1}, I'm talking with my master. Could you go check on him?"
